What goes wrong today

Where small businesses lose time and customers

You compete with companies that have ten times the staff. The gap is not talent, it is hours in the day.

  • You cannot staff WhatsApp, email and phone around the clock, so evening and weekend enquiries wait until Monday.

  • Leads go cold because nobody has time to follow up a second and third time.

  • Old contacts and past clients sit in a spreadsheet or CRM, unused.

  • Admin eats hours every week: reminders, invoices, data entry, reports.

  • There is no clear picture of what is working across sales and marketing, so decisions are made on gut feeling.

How it works

The four systems, applied to a small business

Start with the system that pays back fastest. Add the next one once it runs.

  1. 1💬

    Capture system

    WhatsApp AI · LeadFire

    Every enquiry from WhatsApp, your website and your ads answered in seconds.

    An AI agent on your WhatsApp Business number and web chat answers questions, qualifies the lead by budget and timing and books a call or viewing straight into your calendar. Evenings and weekends included.

    About the capture system
  2. 2🔁

    Follow-up system

    Follow-up sequences · Lead reactivation

    Follow-up for the leads that did not answer, and reactivation of the ones you already have.

    Multi-step follow-up across WhatsApp, email and SMS until the lead replies or opts out. Old contacts in your CRM or inbox get personalised reactivation messages, and the ones who answer are handed to you.

    About the follow-up system
  3. 3📄

    Operations system

    Document processing · AI agents for daily tasks

    Invoices, intake forms and data entry handled by AI agents instead of your team.

    Incoming documents are read, the data goes into your accounting, CRM or spreadsheet and the routine reminders your team sends by hand go out automatically. You check only what is flagged.

    About the operations system
  4. 4📊

    Reporting system

    Weekly report

    One weekly report on leads, sales and team performance instead of five dashboards.

    Every Monday morning: enquiries by channel, response times, conversion, revenue and what to fix this week. Pulled from your tools and written in plain English.

    About the reporting system

What it looks like in your business

The same four systems, set up differently for each kind of business.

Real estate agencies

Contact every property lead in seconds and book viewings on autopilot.

  • Portal, website and WhatsApp enquiries answered in seconds, buyers qualified by budget and timeline, viewings booked into the agent's calendar
  • Multi-month follow-up for long sales cycles, plus reactivation of cold buyer and seller databases
  • Weekly report on which listings, ads and channels generate leads
🛒

E-commerce & Shopify stores

Recover lost revenue and reactivate past customers without more staff.

  • Abandoned-cart and post-purchase follow-up across WhatsApp, email and SMS
  • Reactivation campaigns to past customers, personalised per segment
  • Monday report pulled from Shopify, ad accounts and analytics: what sold, what to cut
⚖️

Finance & legal firms

Automate documents, qualify enquiries instantly and follow up like clockwork.

  • Contracts, invoices and intake forms read by AI, data entered into your CRM, missing items flagged
  • New enquiries qualified and routed to the right advisor within a minute
  • Follow-up sequences for every prospect who did not convert on the first call

Run like a bigger company without hiring like one.
